[Module: Product Detail | TC-002 | Type: Positive | Priority: High]
Title: Remove product from cart when product is InCart (Positive | High)

▶ Start URL:    https://www.saucedemo.com/product-detail.html
▶ Requires Auth: Yes
▶ Test Data:
{
  "username": "standard_user",
  "password": "secret_sauce",
  "initial_product_state": "InCart"
}

Preconditions:
  User is logged in (standard_user); product exists and is in InCart state (Remove button visible).

Steps to Execute:
  1. Navigate to the Product Detail page for the product (open https://www.saucedemo.com/product-detail.html)
  2. Click the Remove button (button[data-test='remove'|id='remove'])

Expected Result:
  The Product Detail page now shows the Add to cart button; product state has changed to NotInCart.

Notes from prior verification:
  No step changes required; verification confirmed the Remove button exists and is clickable.
